WITH keyword_ids AS (
    SELECT k.id
    FROM keyword AS k
    WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
),
movie_ids AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id AS movie_id,
           mc.company_id AS company_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = mk.movie_id
    WHERE mk.keyword_id IN (SELECT id FROM keyword_ids)
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS member_in_charnamed_movie
FROM movie_ids AS fm
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = fm.movie_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = fm.movie_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id AND n.name LIKE '%B%'
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = fm.company_id
